title: USindiwe neeMagameru
description: Kwakukhona umntazanyana igama lakhe kwakunguSindiwe Magona. Wabe anesiphiwo esikhethekileko sendatjana. Ebusuku, ugogo kaSindisiwe khabe amcocela iindatjana ezinomlingo ezimayelana namazimuzimu neenkakaramba, iinlwana zamahlathi, neendalwa ezincani zommango. Lesi kwakusikhathi esithandwa khulu nguSindiwe. Bona bonyana ukhula njani ngokuphila ipilo yamakareko wakhe namavakatjho wangaphetjheya kwelwandle wokobana atjhugulule iphasi ngeendatjana zakhe.
